name: Zigbee
author: NucleoOS
description: Your Zigbee2MQTT network on the panel: every device shows up by itself, switches and lights toggle with a tap, sensors show temperature, humidity, doors, motion and battery. Uses the MQTT broker set in Settings > Home.

descriptions.en: Your Zigbee2MQTT network on the panel: every device shows up by itself, switches and lights toggle with a tap, sensors show temperature, humidity, doors, motion and battery. Uses the MQTT broker set in Settings > Home.
descriptions.it: La tua rete Zigbee2MQTT sul pannello: i dispositivi compaiono da soli, prese e luci si accendono con un tocco, i sensori mostrano temperatura, umidita, porte, movimento e batteria. Usa il broker MQTT impostato in Impostazioni > Casa.
